name: ReactION
description: React Component Visualizer for VS Code

viewsWelcome.contents:
Visualize your React app's live component tree — right inside VS Code.

Step 1 of 3 — Start your React app in development mode (for example, run npm run dev or npm start in your project's terminal).

Once your dev server is running, confirm to continue:
[$(check) My dev server is running](command:ReactION.confirmDevServerRunning)

Step 2 of 3 — Point ReactION at your running app.

Set the URL to match your dev server. ReactION auto-detects the common ports for you.
[$(gear) Configure Dev Server](command:ReactION.setup)

$(pass-filled) Dev server configured.

Step 3 of 3 — Launch the live component graph:
[$(play) Launch ReactION](command:ReactION.openTree)

Need a different URL?
[$(gear) Reconfigure](command:ReactION.setup)

$(check-all) You're all set — ReactION is configured and launched.

[$(play) Launch ReactION](command:ReactION.openTree)

Need help or want to change your setup?
[$(gear) Reconfigure Dev Server](command:ReactION.setup)
[$(book) Help & Troubleshooting](command:ReactION.showWalkthrough)

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with ReactION
walkthroughs.description: Visualize and profile your React app's live component tree inside VS Code.

steps.title: Start your React app in dev mode
steps.description:
ReactION reads a running app through a real Chrome instance, so start your app in development mode first (for example `npm run dev` or `npm start`), then note the URL it serves on.
[Open a Terminal](command:workbench.action.terminal.new)

steps.title: Point ReactION at your dev server
steps.description:
Tell ReactION which URL your app runs on. The setup wizard auto-detects common ports and saves your choice to reactION-config.json.
[Configure Dev Server](command:ReactION.setup)

steps.title: Launch the live component graph
steps.description:
Open the interactive graph of your running app, then click any node to inspect its live props, state, and hooks.
[Launch ReactION](command:ReactION.openTree)

steps.title: Troubleshooting & tips
steps.description:
Graph empty, or Chrome won't launch? Here are the common fixes and where to look.
[Show ReactION Log](command:ReactION.showLog)
